pending_commit.commit_message: CHROMIUM: iwl7000: Merge Core35 driver updates This is a merge commit of all Intel patches for the Core35 driver update since commit 02be2d585fded270a4e7f86b622f9ff42866ae86 and ending at commit b67be178e2e05c8bbccaa2c73dc9899e37d202df. With Core35, iwl7000 goes back to using stock cfg80211, instead of its own version (iwl7000_cfg80211), so this merge depends on other changes that allow iwl7000 to co-exist with the stock wireless stack and other drivers (once again). This merge depends on: - CL:1008644 (revert the "intelwifi38" USE-flag based config fragment since iwlwifi is enabled by default now) - CL:1008844 (revert tricky's use of "intelwifi38") - CL:*606968 (revert falco_li use of "intelwifi38") - CL:1008842 (add iwl7000 back to the kernel config and renormalize) The original branch provided by Intel (Luca Coelho) is at branch core35-for-chromeos-3.8 on https://git.kernel.org/cgit/linux/kernel/git/iwlwifi/chromeos.git and has been mirrored as intel-wifi/v3.8-Core35 on cros. Revert "tricky: Add use flag to use Intel wireless stack." This reverts commit 7b0b9b7360b2ed6ccbfd140cc37e99963fe21309. The Core31 version of the iwl7000 brought in an iwl7000-specific cfg80211 module (iwl7000_cfg80211.ko) which could not co-exist with cfg80211.ko. These changes were made to enable a setup where only one of Intel-wifi or non-Intel-wifi stacks was enabled on a given board image. With Core35, we revert that, and go back to Intel wifi using stock cfg80211, Hence this change to stop using the "intelwifi38" USE flag / config-fragment. The following changes should land together to enable this transition in a single step: - CL:1006658 (add Core35 update to iwl7000) - CL:1008644 (revert the "intelwifi38" USE-flag based config fragment since iwlwifi is enabled by default now) - CL:*606968 (revert falco_li's use of "intelwifi38") - CL:1008842 (add iwl7000 back to the kernel config and renormalize) - CL:1008844 [this CL] (revert tricky's use of "intelwifi38") CQ-DEPEND=CL:1006658, CL:1008644, CL:1008842, CL:*606968 BUG=b:76340244 TEST=trybot on tricky Signed-off-by: Kirtika Ruchandani <kirtika@google.com> Change-Id: Ic1409197b96910472f5973ab710c1c8bec890041 Reviewed-on: https://chromium-review.googlesource.com/1008844 Commit-Ready: Kirtika Ruchandani <kirtika@chromium.org> Tested-by: Kirtika Ruchandani <kirtika@chromium.org> Reviewed-by: Rajat Jain <rajatja@chromium.org> Reviewed-by: Mike Frysinger <vapier@chromium.org>

Revert "cros-kernel2: Add config fragment to use Intel wifi stack" This reverts commit 304d44c08264e3764256dc78cdc8d6dc3f406dd8. The Core31 version of the iwl7000 brought in an iwl7000-specific cfg80211 module (iwl7000_cfg80211.ko) which could not co-exist with cfg80211.ko. These changes were made to enable a setup where only one of Intel-wifi or non-Intel-wifi stacks was enabled on a given board image. Part of these changes to disable iwl7000 reliance on anything related to stock NL80211 or CFG80211 configs. With Core35, we revert that, and go back to Intel wifi using stock CFG80211. Hence no need for special config fragments as iwl7000 can coexist with other wireless stacks. The following changes should land together to enable this transition in a single step: - CL:1006658 (add Core35 update to iwl7000) - CL:1008844 (revert tricky's use of "intelwifi38") - CL:*606968 (revert falco_li's use of "intelwifi38") - CL:1008842 (add iwl7000 back to the kernel config and renormalize) - CL:1008644 [this CL](revert the "intelwifi38" USE-flag based config fragment since iwlwifi is enabled by default now) CQ-DEPEND=CL:1006658, CL:1008644, CL:1008842, CL:*606968 BUG=b/76340244 TEST=build on 3.8 devices (falco_li, leon, mccloud) Change-Id: If5415efdebc0d6d7f645f6d68c57cc66b00bcda4 Reviewed-on: https://chromium-review.googlesource.com/1008644 Commit-Ready: Lepton Wu <lepton@chromium.org> Commit-Ready: Kirtika Ruchandani <kirtika@chromium.org> Tested-by: Kirtika Ruchandani <kirtika@chromium.org> Reviewed-by: Rajat Jain <rajatja@chromium.org> Reviewed-by: Mike Frysinger <vapier@chromium.org>
